Before you press send

Where does my message go?

Nowhere. This local demo validates the form and shows a confirmation, but it does not send email, make a request, or store your message. Please use made-up details when testing.

How would this work on a real site?

A real contact form needs a form plugin or service, spam protection, and an appropriate privacy notice. The theme provides the visual styling; this demo-only form is not part of the deployed theme.
